app_name: Guardian Health & Angel - Sovereign Survival OS
personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (Customized for Premium Minimalist Dark Mode)
personality_one_liner: A $100,000 award-winning, cinematic dark-mode ecosystem where deep charcoal spaces and Guardian Gold accents project unshakeable sovereignty and trust.

spacing.rule: Generous padding and whitespace are critical for the premium feel. Never crowd elements.

do's: Use heavy tint + blur over background textures for premium depth.
Apply to the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use subtle glass effect on 4-Pillar Dashboard cards if imagery is underneath.
dont's: Do not use on body text regions or form inputs.
Do not over-blur without a strong dark tint layer (#121212 at 75% opacity) to preserve readability.

screens.name: Home (4-Pillar Dashboard)
screens.purpose: The commanding entry point offering immediate access to the 4 main interactive pillars.

states.error: Minimalist error state with Guardian Gold 'Retry' pill button.

screens.layout: Grid of 4 large interactive tiles (2x2 layout). Cards have a 24px border radius, subtle border (`border`), and `surfaceSecondary` background. Each tile contains a high-quality Lucide icon (in Guardian Gold), Pillar Title, and microcopy subtitle in Slovak (e.g., 'Zdravotný Trezor', 'Rodinný Štít'). Use `flex: 1` and `aspectRatio: 1` or a calculated 48% width with `space-between` to ensure a balanced, uncrowded layout with generous `xl` padding around the grid.

screens.name: Pillar Hub (Sub-feature list)
screens.purpose: A beautifully uncluttered list of sub-features within a selected pillar.
screens.layout: Vertical list. Each row uses `surfaceSecondary`, large touch targets (min 64px height), 24px radius, and a leading tinted icon container (`brandTertiary` background with `brandPrimary` icon). Subtitles in Slovak. 'Authorship' and 'Pseudonym Protection' tucked cleanly at the bottom of the Profile/Legacy pillar.

screens.name: Angel Mode (Voice AI Jarvis)
screens.purpose: A radical full-screen, distraction-free voice AI interface for immediate sovereign assistance.
screens.layout: Full-screen abstract dark/gold background (`angel_bg`) with a heavy dark vertical scrim (top-to-bottom 30% to 90% opacity). Center: One massive, pulsing Guardian Gold orb/button ('Talk to Jarvis'). Use `react-native-reanimated` for infinite breathing/pulse scaling. Bottom safe-area: 3 large square tiles (SOS, Family, Doctor) containing only large Lucide icons, styled in `surfaceTertiary` with 24px radius. No sub-menus or lists.

angel_bg.alt: Intricate gold abstract sculpture against a dark background, exuding elegance and modernity.

instructions_to_main_agent: MANDATORY: Map the exact hex values provided in the `color` block to the existing `C.*` tokens in `src/theme.ts` (bg, fg, surface2, surface3, onS3, inverse, onInverse, brand, brandPri, brandSec, brandTer, warn, onWarn, error, onError, info, border, borderStrong). This ensures the ~25 existing screens seamlessly adopt the premium dark mode.

Implement the 4-Pillar Dashboard precisely: 2x2 grid, 24px border radius (`lg` mapped to 24), `surfaceSecondary` fill, Guardian Gold (#D4AF37) accent icons, and crisp Slovak microcopy (Health Hub, Family Shield, Legacy & Wealth, The Hunter).

Angel Mode MUST be a full-screen radical reset. Hide the standard header and tab bar if possible, or build it as a full-screen modal/overlay. The background must use `angel_bg` overlaid with a dark vertical scrim (LinearGradient from top 30% to bottom 90% black/charcoal) so the UI pops. The central 'Talk to Jarvis' button requires a continuous infinite pulse animation using `react-native-reanimated`.
For the bottom tab bar, use 4 icons representing the pillars. Keep it exceptionally clean with a glassmorphism blur background and safe-area padding.
Ensure typography uses `Satoshi` (or fallback `Plus Jakarta Sans`) consistently. Restrict font weights to 400 and 500 ONLY. Create visual hierarchy through font size, not weight.
Eliminate redundant tables or cluttered lists; any sub-feature screen (Pillar Hub) must use spacious list rows with tinted icon containers.
Do NOT use any blues, indigos, or purples anywhere in the app, sticking strictly to the charcoal, white, and Guardian Gold palette.
